chapter_seo_title: Treasure Competition Assembly: Ji Ning Bids Against the Shaoyan Clan
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning joins Heavenly Treasures Mountain's monthly auction, bidding against the Shaoyan clan for a legendary formation diagram. A mysterious red-robed elder enters the fray.
og_title: Auction Bidding War – Ji Ning vs the Shaoyan Clan
og_description: Ji Ning makes his name known in the Grand Xia capital by bidding against the Shaoyan clan at Heavenly Treasures Mountain's treasure assembly.
twitter_description: A mysterious elder outbids the Shaoyan clan for a legendary formation diagram at the Grand Xia capital's treasure assembly.

lore_anchors.definition: A grand tournament held by the Grand Xia Dynasty to recruit the most talented Wanxiang Adepts from across the realm; winners are often taken as disciples by supreme powers of the Three Realms.
A monthly high-stakes auction hosted by Heavenly Treasures Mountain's headquarters where rare and unique treasures sometimes appear.
Two legendary demon Celestial Immortals renowned as grandmasters of formations, said to have studied under an exalted figure of the Three Realms.
A scroll or carving that contains the essence of an array technique; fully comprehending one can allow a cultivator to become a formation grandmaster.
The ultimate essence of natural energy, used as high-value currency for large purchases among cultivators.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Immortal Fortunes Assembly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a grand tournament hosted by the Grand Xia Dynasty to recruit the most talented Wanxiang Adepts from across the realm; winners often become disciples of supreme powers of the Three Realms.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the red-robed elder outbid the Shaoyan clan?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is either an ally of Ji Ning or someone with his own score to settle against the Shaoyan clan; his identity remains a mystery.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning want to be seen at the auction?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He needs to make his name known in the capital so that powerful clans (like the Zhuanshui clan) will learn of his presence and potentially offer alliances against the Shaoyan clan.
